title: Left geometric refinements on normalized coefficient stages
statement: Under exactly the geometric and coefficient hypotheses of the normalized coefficient construction, let R,F,M be ring, rational and common-stage records satisfying CoefficientConstructionNormalization. There exists CoefficientLeftRefinements R F M: left comparison isomorphisms, their shifts, their canonical proper/open ring realization, their raw localization formula and their common-field conjugation formula. This asserts no right comparison or adjunction compatibility equations. It is the left geometric part of construction step 6.

source.place: Left geometric refinements on normalized coefficient stages; normalized coefficient construction in the existing assembly node.

proof.text: Construct the ring-stage proper/open refinement together with its integral scalar square. Localize the integral isomorphisms using the fixed rational functors and equal localization shift structures. At the closed stage conjugate the rational components by the supplied common-field q maps. The rational scalar square and commonTransitionNatural give compatibility along transitions. Every pair-category arrow factors through transitions and a stage arrow, so this defines a natural isomorphism. Its shift square follows after precomposition with each stage inclusion, since the common shift structures agree. Assemble the four Stage cases; the ring normalization, rational HEq and common conjugation formula are then the respective component equations.
